notes.title: Strayed Lights Anniversary: A Gleaming Update for You!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We're absolutely thrilled to celebrate Strayed Lights' first birthday with you!

This past year has been an incredible journey, and we wouldn't be here without the amazing support of our fantastic community. A heartfelt [b]thank you[/b] goes out to each and every one of you who's played, shared, and provided feedback on Strayed Lights. [b]We hear you[/b], and we're dedicated to bringing you the best possible experience.

To celebrate this milestone and show our appreciation, we're rolling out a special anniversary update! This update focuses on making Strayed Lights shine even brighter, with:
[list]
[*][b]Performance Optimizations[/b]: We've implemented optimizations to ensure a smoother, more enjoyable experience.
[*][b]Bug Fixes[/b]: Thanks to your valuable feedback, we've squashed a number of pesky bugs that were reported by the community.
[/list]

We hope this update lets you explore the world of Strayed Lights with renewed joy. We're constantly working to improve the game, and your continued feedback is invaluable to us. Here's to another year of dazzling adventures together!

[b]Stay tuned[/b] for more exciting news from Embers!

[b]Thank You![/b]

notes.title: New difficulty modes added to Strayed Lights
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

We were very touched by the fantastic feedback we got from the latest "Trials" update. It seems that players have acquired a taste for taking on the best and most difficult that Strayed Lights can offer.

As part of our update roadmap, we're proud to introduce the next stage of development on Strayed Lights as we introduce the new "Challenge" and "Story" modes.

[h2]Challenge Mode[/h2]

The Challenge mode pushes players to the limit on their quest for enlightenment, with bosses and enemy encounters given a massively increased challenge, with all-new boss content in the form of new attacks and animations.

Your quest will now be measured in inches, rather than miles -- as the forces of corruption push back against you. For those who craved a true test of their abilities, we invite you to take on Challenge mode, available with today's update!

[h2]Story Mode[/h2]

On the other side of the coin, the world of Strayed Lights is one worth experiencing for itself, whether you're accustomed to fighting for your life or not. While not removing challenge entire, "Story Mode" is a new update for players who want to take in the world around them, rather than contend with danger at every turn.

-

We're excited to hear feedback from players on this new content, and hope to see you on our public Discord, where we'd love to hear your thoughts. To all those who journeyed with us along the way: thank you for your support!

               - The Embers Team

notes.title: New Strayed Lights Update : Trials and Memories Modes!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Everyone![/b]

Over a month has passed since the release of Strayed Lights, and we've been hard at work making post-release adjustment patches and filing down some hard edges. 

First of all, we really appreciate the positive feedback and great suggestions we've gotten from players. It's been a huge help in identifying performance issues on launch. From across Discord and social media, players have been supportive along the way. 

And second of all, we've been listening closely to critical feedback on the game's difficulty. Of course, everyone has their own preference for difficulty and challenge, but several Strayed Lights players have been calling for some content that can really challenge them. 

[h2]Introducing Strayed Lights "Trials"[/h2]

In the “Trials” mode, players will be challenged to take on the myriad of powerful bosses in Strayed Lights at the apex of their strength and do so without dying.  Bosses have all new combos and abilities and push you to the brink.  Trials will be available upon completing the game.

We had a blast taking the gloves off with some of our creations, and we're excited to see if players can rise to the challenge!

[h2]Revisit Old Fights in "Memories" mode[/h2]

With “Memories,” players can confront any previously defeated boss, both in their original difficulty and new, unleashed forms. This is available upon beating the any boss and allows the player to revisit any major battle at any time. 

A few fights really captivated some players, and we wanted to give them the opportunity to rechallenge them.

[h2]Looking Ahead, Updates over Summer[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43542040/634c4feb9106472e80cdd76ba30981d052f7b38d.jpg[/img]

We have additional updates planned over the course of the summer to add additional challenge and new ways to experience the game. As always, we'll be excited to share developments as they come closer to fruition.

New game modes will be in the works over the next couple of weeks. But until then, we hope you enjoy "Trials". Let us know what you think of these difficult new encounters on our [url=https://discord.gg/UndEuYzkV5]Public Discord[/url]. 

All the Best!

The Embers Team

notes.title: Strayed Lights is out NOW!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

Years and years of work, sweat, caffeine and stress have poured into creating our studio's first game. And we're proud to present Strayed Lights to the world!

[previewyoutube=0ALfzd6EG7I;full][Trailer][/previewyoutube]

Seek transcendence in a corrupted world. Beginning as only the faintest of lights, you must learn to balance your energy and protect yourself from the shadows that surround you. 

Strayed Lights drew inspiration from games that demand fast reflexes and proactive decisionmaking, but we also wanted to create a game that had a deliberate ebb and flow. The result is a uniquely graceful action experience that we feel is wholly unique. Combined with an otherworldly and dreamlike art direction, Strayed Lights was born.

We want to give a huge thanks to friends and family who supported us through development. And we'd like a huge thank you to fans and well-wishers who found us throughout our journey. We're so proud of the game we've created and we can't wait for you to experience it.

As we move further into launch, you can connect with the Strayed Lights community on our [url=https://discord.gg/qHmkcQvJRD]Public Discord[/url]. And follow [url=https://twitter.com/embersgames]our Twitter[/url] for updates on the game as they come.

The journey has only begun.

The Embers Team

notes.title: Pre-Orders on Strayed Lights now available with Bonus Content!
notes.content:
[i]Hello everyone!
[/i]
We're excited to announce that Pre-Orders are available for Strayed Lights across multiple platforms, including for Steam. We've included some bonuses to get you excited for the incredible journey when Strayed Lights releases on all platforms on April 25th.

[previewyoutube=FtmX30vStes;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

We've had such fantastic support from fans and well-wishers, both online and in-person at PAX just last month. As part of our pre-order bonus, in addition to the game, you'll receive:

[b]The Strayed Lights Original Soundtrack[/b]

Available in both MP3 and lossless formats, and composed by Austin Wintory. Each track crafted in time with the enchanting environments and unique creatures you'll battle in Strayed Lights.

[b]The Strayed Lights Art Book[/b]

We've put together early development models, prototypes, high-quality renders and beautiful hand-drawn art together in an all-encompassing artistic window into the development of the game. With over 50 pages of high-quality game art, you'll get a unique look into the challenges and inspirations behind the development of Embers' first release.

[h2][url=https://embers.games/strayed-lights/]Pre-Order Strayed Lights from Our Website![/url][/h2]

Pre-Order comes with all these bonuses at the value of the game on release! 

We'll have more details to share about the release as we get closer to the day. Stay tuned as we kick off the final weeks before the game ships!

Sincerely,

[b]The Embers Team[/b]

notes.title: Strayed Lights coming to PAX Rising Showcase 2023!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

Hot off the heels of releasing our demo as part of MIX 2023, we're proud to announce our attendance at the PAX Rising Showcase. We've flown out to Boston as part of the event to show off a new build of the game, including a new boss and an exclusive hands-on demo down at[b] booth #13097.[/b]

We'll also have some new updates surrounding console releases and bonus content that will be available a little closer to launch. We want to capture the world and magic that brought the world of Strayed Lights to live, and we know you'll be just as excited for what's to come.

The Demo is still available. And we're excited to hear what excites you about the game! Join us on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/qHmkcQvJRD]Discord community[/url], or follow us on  [url=https://twitter.com/embersgames]Twitter[/url] and drop a message what you've loved.

All the best,

The Embers Team

notes.title: Strayed Lights Demo now Available during The MIX 2023
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

Over the last few months, we've been hard at work on the upcoming release of Strayed Lights. We are thrilled to be able to share our new gameplay trailer and demo with fans of the game. 

This has been a passion project a long time in the making, and we're incredibly excited to show you the visually outstanding world of Strayed Lights and give you a chance to get a hands-on look at the gameplay today.

This Friday, March 17th, Strayed Lights will be a part of the upcoming Media Indie Exchange Showcase 2023 with a gameplay reveal trailer and a limited-time game demo available only on Steam!

[previewyoutube=FpNOX950wHI;full][/previewyoutube]

Venture through an oneiric world imbued with mystery. The path to transcendence will begin with you as a tiny, faint light. Explore an otherworldly land and balance your energy to defeat countless foes within the shadows.

[b]The demo will be available for a limited time during the MIX Event! [/b] Strayed Lights will launch on April 25 across PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, and PC.

For updates on Strayed Lights as we approach release, please join us on our public [url=https://discord.com/invite/qHmkcQvJRD]Discord community[/url], or follow us on any of all of our [url=https://twitter.com/embersgames]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/embersgames/]Instagram[/url], or [url=https://www.facebook.com/EmbersGames]Facebook[/url] accounts, where we keep you posted as Strayed Lights nears its release day.

A big thank you to all the community members who have supported us through this journey. We can't wait to show you what we have in store.

All the best,

[b]The Embers Team[/b]
